Quick answer AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) structures content so it can be lifted as a direct answer. GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) makes your brand likely to be cited inside AI-generated responses. LLMO (Large Language Model Optimisation) makes your organisation factually retrievable and correctly described by models. PressCosmos applies all three to every press release it distributes.

The three disciplines

AEO, GEO and LLMO — what each one actually means

AEO

Answer Engine Optimisation

Optimising for the machine that answers a question directly.

  • A 40–60 word answer block near the top of the release
  • Question-shaped subheadings and FAQ pairs
  • FAQPage structured data on every FAQ section
  • Tables and lists that survive being extracted

GEO

Generative Engine Optimisation

Optimising to be cited inside a generated response, with attribution.

  • Independent corroboration across syndicated outlets
  • Entity-consistent naming of your organisation
  • Original data points that are worth quoting
  • Stable canonical URLs so citations do not rot

LLMO

Large Language Model Optimisation

Optimising what a model knows and says about your brand.

  • Organization schema with identity, location and contacts
  • llms.txt guidance plus an open crawler policy
  • Machine-readable feeds and a clean sitemap
  • Clear, factual, unembellished claims

Mechanics

What we change in the release itself

Before

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Acme Corp Announces Exciting New Synergy Initiative!

Acme, a leading provider of innovative solutions, today announced a groundbreaking initiative that will transform the industry landscape and deliver unprecedented value to stakeholders across the ecosystem...

After

Acme Corp launches supplier emissions reporting for 1,200 manufacturers

SAN FRANCISCO, October 22, 2026 — Acme Corp today launched Supplier Carbon Ledger, a reporting tool that lets 1,200 manufacturers calculate Scope 3 emissions from their supply chains. The company says the tool reduces reporting time from six weeks to four days. Pricing starts at $900 per month.

Named entity · specific numbers · direct answer · attribution-ready

Measurement

Share of answer, not share of voice

Citation rate

How often you appear in responses to your tracked question set, per engine.

Accuracy score

Whether the facts the model states about you are correct and current.

Source mix

Which of your pages and which third-party outlets the model cited.

Category ownership

Your share of citations against named competitors for the same questions.

See how this reports alongside traffic and revenue

Caveats

What we cannot do

We can make your announcement retrievable, answerable, attributable and corroborated. We cannot force a language model to prefer you over a competitor, and neither can anyone else who is being straight with you.

What we will do is measure honestly: if your citation rate does not move, the report will say so, and we will tell you what we would change next time.

No prompt injection, no manipulation We do not bury instructions in copy, stuff hidden text, or attempt to game retrieval. It breaks eventually, and it is a reputational risk we will not take on your behalf.
Results are lagged Model freshness varies. Expect 2–8 weeks before a change in retrievability reliably shows up in citation share.

Answers

AI visibility questions

Still stuck? Talk to a specialist

AEO is Answer Engine Optimisation — structuring content so it can be lifted as a direct answer. GEO is Generative Engine Optimisation — being cited inside AI-generated responses. LLMO is Large Language Model Optimisation — making your brand factually retrievable and correctly described by models. PressCosmos applies all three to every release.

We publish each release as clean semantic HTML with NewsArticle and Organization structured data, a plain-language summary block, stable canonical URLs and machine-readable feeds, then allow the major AI crawlers in robots.txt. Combined, those signals make your announcement retrievable, quotable and attributable.

ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Overviews, Meta AI, Grok and You.com. Share-of-answer tracking reports how often and how accurately your brand appears in responses for your tracked question set.

No, it compounds it. Search rankings and AI citations draw on overlapping signals: authority, entity clarity, structured data and third-party corroboration. A press release strategy serves both at once.
